_meta.status: FILLED 2026-11-03. Read by Claude from rendered page images (pypdfium2, 3x), with accounting identities cross-checked per statement. NOT fully independent: the reader had seen FinAgent's blind output before reading. Owner should spot-check before treating as final.
method: Read every value from the PDF PAGE ITSELF (zoom in). Never copy from FinAgent's output or the blind-run JSON: the golden must be independent of the thing it grades.
Number exactly as printed, in the report's own unit: commas removed, brackets -> negative. e.g. '(9,812.40)' -> -9812.4
Cross-check while reading: total assets = total equity and liabilities; closing cash on the cash-flow statement vs balance-sheet cash. If an identity fails, re-read before writing.
If a metric is genuinely not printed (e.g. a bank has no profit-before-tax line), set "value": null and "not_printed": true. Then MISSING counts as correct.
Ambiguous variants (continuing vs discontinued operations, before/after minority interest): pick the total for the year, and write which line you used in "label" plus a "note".
Fill "page" with the 1-based PDF page number you read it from.
